proof:
classical
unfold QuantumHarnessFrozenTarget
intro m P v i b hP
unfold M6.Pinned.agrees
constructor
· intro h
  constructor
  · intro j
    by_cases hji : j = i
    · subst j
      simp [hP]
    · simpa [M6.Pinned.pin, Function.update, hji, Ne.symm hji] using h j
  · simpa [M6.Pinned.pin, Function.update] using h i
· rintro ⟨h, hv⟩ j
  by_cases hji : j = i
  · subst j
    simp [M6.Pinned.pin, Function.update, hv]
  · simpa [M6.Pinned.pin, Function.update, hji, Ne.symm hji] using h j
